subscriptions.name: Fly.io
subscriptions.notes: App meme-ops: shared-cpu-1x 512MB, iad, auto_stop_machines=stop, min_machines_running=0. Signed up 2026-09-11. $0 now (trial / no invoice yet). Seth initially thought this was a 30-day trial; ledger uses official published terms, not that assumption.
subscriptions.trial_note: Published trial (https://fly.io/docs/about/free-trial/): 2 total VM-hours or 7 days, whichever comes first. Adding a payment method ends the trial and starts pay-as-you-go.
subscriptions.post_trial_note: Pay-as-you-go. Official always-on ceiling for shared-cpu-1x 512MB is ~$3.32 / 30 days (https://fly.io/docs/about/pricing/). Auto-stop should keep actual $ lower. No hobby-plan minimum.
